title: Physical Operating-Condition-Guided Vision-Language Matching for Cavitation Diagnosis in Industrial Pipeline Systems
abstract: arXiv:2610.27860v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Cavitation diagnosis in industrial pipeline systems is challenging because acoustic responses vary substantially with operating conditions, while similar time-frequency patterns may correspond to different cavitation states. To address this issue, we propose a physical operating-condition-guided vision-language matching (POC-VLM) for cavitation diagnosis. POC-VLM first constructs physical operating-condition-aware semantic descriptions by explicitly incorporating sample-specific operating variables into candidate cavitation texts. A time-frequency-conditioned text adaptation module then dynamically aligns these physical semantics with the observed acoustic response, followed by global-local vision-language matching to capture both holistic and localized discriminative patterns. translated_title: 面向工业管道系统空化诊断的物理运行工况引导的视觉-语言匹配方法
translated_abstract: 工业管道系统中的空化诊断面临挑战，因为声学响应随运行工况变化显著，而相似的时频模式可能对应不同的空化状态。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种物理运行工况引导的视觉-语言匹配方法（POC-VLM）用于空化诊断。POC-VLM首先通过将样本特定的运行变量显式融入候选空化文本来构建物理运行工况感知的语义描述。随后，时频条件文本自适应模块将这些物理语义与观测到的声学响应进行动态对齐，并通过全局-局部视觉-语言匹配来捕获整体和局部的判别性模式。同时，基于K近邻的非参数物理运行工况先验估计每个候选状态的物理合理性并进行融合（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种物理运行工况引导的视觉-语言匹配方法POC-VLM，通过将运行工况变量显式融入候选空化文本语义并动态对齐声学时频特征，显著提升了工业管道系统中空化诊断的准确性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes POC-VLM, a physical operating-condition-guided vision-language matching method that explicitly incorporates operating variables into candidate cavitation texts and dynamically aligns them with acoustic time-frequency features, significantly improving cavitation diagnosis accuracy in industrial pipeline systems.
